summary: Adds a leading space to the Case template so COUNT(DISTINCT ...) no longer collides with CASE, correctly fixing the malformed SQL. The change is minimal and matches the existing SQL-assembly style in expressions.py.

issues.description: Leading space in the template is a slightly blunt fix (the extra space is harmless but relies on SQL whitespace tolerance rather than fixing joiner logic at the call site); acceptable and consistent with how other templates handle spacing in this file.
